featured_techniques.technique: Rethinking decision making to earn customer trust

sections.description: Beloved companies share five active and purposeful decisions that guide conduct: believe; clarity of purpose; be real; be there; say sorry. These decisions drive devoted customers and business growth.
sections.title: The five decisions to become beloved

sections.description: Decisions are guided by the intent and motivation behind them, driven by awareness of and empathy for customers; when what you want to accomplish and why you act align with customer understanding, outcomes will set you apart.
sections.title: Intent and empathy behind decision making

summary: Jeanne Bliss outlines a concise, five‑step decision framework for turning customers into devoted fans. The talk centers on aligning organizational decisions with empathy for customers and clearly stated purpose. The five active decisions—believe, clarity of purpose, be real, be there, and say sorry—are presented as drivers of trust, better customer relationships, and sustainable growth. Bliss emphasizes that the outcomes of decisions shape what customers, employees, and the broader market think of a brand, and that rethinking decision making is a practical path to becoming beloved.
title: Five Decisions to Grow Your Company into a Beloved Brand
